summary: Backend-only contract verification for SCRIPT M8 voice pipeline fix. All 6 targeted tests passed: /api/health baseline, POST /api/scripts returns uppercase character names (JACK, DET. HARRIS, SARAH), parser DialogueLine.character matches Script.characters[].name case-sensitively for all speakers, POST /api/rehearsals persists reader_style='emotional'+voice_speed=0.9, defaults to 'neutral'/1.0 when omitted, and GET /api/rehearsals/{id} returns the persisted values.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 3895 lines — should be split into routers/models/services modules (>700 line rule).

RehearsalCreate.voice_speed has no Field(ge=..., le=...) validation; a client sending voice_speed=100 or -5 would be persisted verbatim. Consider a Pydantic Field(ge=0.5, le=2.0) bound aligned with the frontend slider range.
reader_style is a free-form str — a Literal['neutral','emotional','aggressive'] or Enum would prevent typos from silently persisting and reaching TTS.
seed_data_creation: One TEST_M8_voice_pipeline script + 3 rehearsals created via public API during test run (module-scoped fixtures). No manual DB seeding.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend contract for M8 voice pipeline (reader_style/voice_speed persistence + uppercase character-name parity between Script.characters[].name and DialogueLine.character) is green. Frontend voice-picker → TTS wiring, VOICE_PICKER_SELECTION / REHEARSAL_VOICE_ASSIGNMENTS / TTS_REQUEST / TTS_RESPONSE / AUDIO_PLAYBACK diagnostics, and audio-cache-keyed-by-voiceId invalidation are covered by static regression suites (test_voice_pipeline_hardening_feb2026.py, test_voice_assignment_functional_feb2026.py) and still require physical device validation on the next QA APK build.
rca of the issue: N/A — backend already implements the persistence contract correctly (RehearsalCreate/RehearsalSession fields at server.py:637-646 / 614-635, wired at line ~2130). The M8 'voice: alloy override' bug is entirely a frontend voice-assignment-map lookup + TTS request-construction issue, not a backend contract gap.
